/bin/zsh -lc "rtk python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
packages = {\"beautifulsoup4\", \"Pillow\", \"playwright\", \"requests\", \"soupsieve\", \"greenlet\", \"pyee\", \"typing-extensions\", \"certifi\", \"charset-normalizer\", \"idna\", \"urllib3\"}
seen = set()
for page in range(1, 11):
    request = Request(f\"https://api.github.com/advisories?ecosystem=pip&per_page=100&page={page}\", headers={\"Accept\": \"application/vnd.github+json\", \"User-Agent\": \"gate7-review\"})
    with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
        payload = json.load(response)
    if not payload:
        break
    for advisory in payload:
        matches = [v for v in advisory.get(\"vulnerabilities\", []) if v.get(\"package\", {}).get(\"name\", \"\").lower() in {p.lower() for p in packages}]
        if not matches or advisory[\"ghsa_id\"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(advisory[\"ghsa_id\"])
        print(json.dumps({\"ghsa_id\": advisory[\"ghsa_id\"], \"severity\": advisory.get(\"severity\"), \"published_at\": advisory.get(\"published_at\"), \"updated_at\": advisory.get(\"updated_at\"), \"summary\": advisory.get(\"summary\"), \"vulnerabilities\": matches, \"html_url\": advisory.get(\"html_url\")}, sort_keys=True))
PY"
